facts.fact: MINTTICS says the national space programme office GGPEN developed AI platforms in use, including Tech Minas supporting and monitoring mining activity and Tech Ecologia detecting and alerting on offshore oil spills.
MINTTICS says GGPEN's AI platforms serve mining (Tech Minas), offshore oil (Tech Ecologia) and agriculture (Tech Agro, analysing fields from satellite and drone data).
facts.system: Tech Minas; Tech Ecologia; Tech Agro

systems.platform: AI on satellite and drone data
